relevance_note: The paper describes four TNFAIP3 carriers in one family: 'A heterozygous c.1727dupC variant in the TNFAIP3 gene (NM_006290), introducing the frameshift variant p.His577Alafs*95, was identified in the Pt1 and her mother (Pt 4)'.
method_note: Hand extraction; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans. Table 1 has one row per (patient, manifestation); 'Pt 1' etc. in the table are the same people as Pt1-Pt4 in the text; labels use the text form 'Pt1'. The father is included as 'father of Pt1' because he was tested in the trio NGS ('performed first on Pt1 and her parents') and in functional assays; the paper does not state his variant result explicitly (only that the variant was found in Pt1 and her mother), so he has no variant row and all checklist items are not reported. Recurrent fever is excluded for Pt1, Pt2 and Pt4 from 'Only Pt3 presented with recurrent episodes of fevers in childhood' (named group). Counts without names (thyroiditis 3/4, arthritis 2/4, genital ulcers in 1 patient, anti-thyroid antibodies in three out of 4, pSTAT1 increased in 3 out of 4 patients) were not used to exclude anyone. Pt3 'no autoimmune manifestation up to the age of 14' is recorded as one excluded feature ('autoimmune manifestation'); it was not spread to specific checklist items (thyroiditis, diabetes etc.), which stay not reported. GH secretion test normal (Pt2, Pt3) recorded as growth hormone deficiency excluded (D-27). Autoantibody checklist 'observed' for Pt1, Pt2, Pt4 rests on anti-TPO/anti-TG values above the normal values in the table note and the column heading 'Autoantibody Positivity'. Pt4 anti-TG 77 U/ml is listed under 'Autoantibody Positivity' but is below the stated normal value (<100 U/ml); no anti-TG row was recorded for Pt4. Abstract calls the four patients 'consanguineous' (blood relatives); this is not a statement of parental consanguinity, so consanguinity is not reported. Pt2 and Pt3: the paper says 'The same frameshift mutation' was present (Sanger) without stating zygosity for them, so zygosity is not reported; inheritance maternal because their mother Pt4 carries the variant. Pathogenicity 'novel pathogenic mutation' is stated for the single variant of the family. Age at onset 'Early childhood (less than 2 years)' given no ISO value (upper bound only). Discrepancies noted: Pt3 is '13 year-old' in Patients but Results say 'no autoimmune manifestation up to the age of 14'; Pt2 short stature '3° centile' in text vs '3°-25° centile' in Table 1; Pt4 'adult height is 10-20° centile' in text vs 'Short stature (10-25°)' in Table 1. Vital status not stated explicitly for anyone. No stacked cells.
